events.strEvent: UFC Fight Night 293 Cortes Acosta vs Walker
events.strFilename: UFC 2026-11-07 UFC Fight Night 293 Cortes Acosta vs Walker
events.strDescriptionEN: Waldo Cortes Acosta faces Johnny Walker in a heavyweight main event at the Meta APEX in Las Vegas. Cortes-Acosta enters ranked No. 6 and looks to strengthen his position in the UFC heavyweight title picture, while Walker makes a quick turnaround after a successful heavyweight debut. With both fighters carrying significant knockout power, the replacement main event has clear divisional implications.
